title: Sparse block-scaled MXFP8 GEMM (SM100, 128x128x256 tile)

computation.summary: The kernel multiplies a 2:4-sparse e4m3 matrix A by a dense e4m3 matrix B, applying ue8m0 block scales, with configured alpha 1 and beta 0, and writes f16 D.
computation.caption: K is the shared reduction axis; these are logical dimensions. A is stored compressed (A.compressed) with E.metadata; scale_a and scale_b are block scales; C is a declared f16 input; D is the f16 output.

finding.summary: A sparse-metadata copy into tensor memory (tcgen05.cp) and a later sparse MMA appear as an unordered pair in the retained record. The pair is a candidate only; the saved search was not complete, and no missing wait is established.

code.caption: Metadata copy, its elect guard, and the first two sparse MMAs.
code.roles: %p211 is true when the elect.sync flag is 0, skipping the copy. The copy writes tensor memory at [%r1540]; the MMAs name metadata at [%r1540] and [%r1550]. The saved read is not mapped to an operand.
code.scope: Local eligibility only: this shows which elect outcome may issue if the block is reached, not the recorded issuing thread.

completion.explanation: PTX 9.2 treats tcgen05.cp.cta_group::N followed by tcgen05.mma.cta_group::N as a pipelined pairing; PTX documents a same-thread pattern needing no explicit ordering. Whether it applies here is open: the issuing-thread relation of the two sites is not saved.

next: Obtain the issuing thread of the copy (event 258) and of the second MMA (event 3072), and an effect-to-operand mapping for the 8-byte read. If both come from one thread, the pipelined same-thread pairing applies.

source_sections.title: What the two operations are
source_sections.answer: The first access is a tcgen05.cp writing sparsity metadata into tensor memory; the second is the second tcgen05.mma.sp in the same K-block, which names a different metadata operand register than the copy destination.

steps.label: Copy
steps.text: Line 6347 copies via descriptor %rd87 into tensor address %r1540 = %r1593 + 256 (line 6113). A second 128x128b copy at 6352 targets %r1562 = %r1593 + 260 (line 6152).

steps.label: MMAs
steps.text: The first MMA (6395) takes metadata at [%r1540]; the second (6426) at [%r1550] = %r1593 + 258 (line 6173). The retained pair, not this operand arithmetic, supplies the byte intersection.

steps.label: Saved pair
steps.text: The retained record pairs a 16-byte write at line 6347 with an 8-byte read at line 6426, intersecting in an 8-byte tensor-memory region. The read is not attributed to a specific operand.

source_sections.title: Who may issue
source_sections.answer: Each copy and MMA sits behind its own elect.sync test, so only the elected lane of a warp may issue it if the block is reached. Whether the copy and the second MMA share a lane is not derived here.

steps.label: Copy guard
steps.text: elect.sync at 6334 sets %r1521 to 1 for the elected lane. %p211 = (%r1521 == 0) at 6340; the branch at 6341 jumps to $L__BB1_84 when true, skipping the copies at 6347-6365.

steps.label: MMA #2 guard
steps.text: A separate elect.sync (6407) sets %r1544; %p213 = (%r1544 == 0) at 6413 and the branch at 6414 skips the MMA at 6426 when true.

steps.label: Limit
steps.text: Election is a separate event per site; the result's election assumption selects lane zero when participating. Actor IDs are not CUDA coordinates, so this does not establish a recorded issuer.

source_sections.title: Accumulator control in the loop
source_sections.answer: The first MMA accumulates only after the first iteration; the next three always accumulate. This concerns the accumulator, not the metadata overlap.

steps.label: First MMA flag
steps.text: Predicate p is (%r1630 != 0) at 6394. %r1630 is set to 0 at 6283 before the loop and to 1 at 6518 at the end of each iteration, so the first pass starts a fresh accumulator and later passes accumulate.

steps.label: Other three
steps.text: MMAs at 6426, 6457 and 6488 each set their flag register to 1 (6421, 6452, 6483) immediately before use.
